name: headroom
description: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.

issues.title: [BUG] Proxy leaks compression-executor threads (image OCR?), pinning cores.
[BUG] security-model.mdx says an unsafe x-headroom-base-url override is "ignored", but the proxy routes answer 400
[BUG] CCR recovery JSON re-offloaded through Codex functions.exec wrapper; named retrieval exemption passes
[FEATURE] please add wrap support for prime-agent
[FEATURE] Pre-upstream context limit guard — hard-cap input tokens to avoid upstream 400 + client retry storm
[FEATURE] One consolidated `headroom uninstall` command + document teardown in --help and README
[BUG] Proactive context expansion injects stale CCR contexts in fast agentic sessions
[FEATURE] headroom wrap support for Kilo Code (VS Code, CLI, Cloud)

discussions.title: RFC: one label set for request attribution (project, client, host, …) instead of one axis per dimension
Headroom as a baseline in a study on learned field projections for agent tool outputs
Measured byte-level savings on Windows: tool output -71.1%, path list -92.0%, build log +0.7%
Question about MCP-only mode in Codex Desktop: Who evaluates the need for compression and on what basis?
Any plan to add support for Mimocode Desktop for Windows?
OpusBar: a macOS menu bar app for Claude Code and Codex usage, limits and waiting sessions
README idea: HVTrust badge linking to Headroom's independent trust profile

* **packaging:** keep PyTorch extras out of all ([#4067](https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom/issues/4067))
